تحتقري (form VIII)
# تَحْتَقِرِي (taḥtaqirī) /taħ.ta.qi.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# تُحْتَقَرِي (tuḥtaqarī) /tuħ.ta.qa.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
